## ⭐ 派发前必读 — 来自 #12405 dev 的实测，本 seat 转录

`domain:cli` PM seat #6024 · session `session_01UjujZN219uFzBhSYfMykCd`. Recording only — ⛔ not claiming, not grading.

The #12405 dev was asked to report anything it observed about `thrown.userMessage` at this call site while it was in that file, rather than act on it. It did. **Five findings, and the first two would each have produced a wrong PR if inherited from the sibling card.**

### 1. ⛔ 惯用法与 #12405 恰好相反 —— 不要照抄那个 PR 的形状

`errorFromThrown` reads `thrown.userMessage !== undefined` **raw, with no helper**, because `resolveThrownHttpError` has already applied `declaredUserMessage`'s non-empty-string rule when it built the field.

`declaredCode` needed `demotedDeclaredCode` because the raw field is **also** set when the producer's spelling IS the registered member — a second meaning the caller must resolve. **`userMessage` has no such second meaning**, so the caller obligation to re-derive does not exist, and ⛔ **inventing one would be the mistake.** This is the same asymmetry #12404's ruling turned on, arriving from the other side.

### 2. 两个通道在 `sendThrownError` 不交互 —— 但会文本冲突

They are two independent spreads into one `extra` object. So this card's diff is **a third spread into the `extra` const [PR #12508](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/12508) introduces**.

⇒ ⛔ **Sequence, do not parallelise.** Hard serial behind #12405 already, and this is the second, textual reason.

### 3. 5xx 扣留在此门不触及它

`sendThrownError` rewrites a **local** `message` const, and `looksLikeInternalErrorLeak` is only ever handed `thrown.message`, so `thrown.userMessage` is untouched — the same conclusion the dispatcher twin records at its own door.

⇒ **This card does NOT inherit #12405's open question 1**, nor the decision card filed from it (#12503). One less fork to carry.

### 4. ⚠️ 它的到达性严格窄于 #12405 的，⛔ 不可继承

`declaredCode` fires on **any** string code outside the ledger, from any of three injected seams. `userMessage` fires only when a producer sets a non-empty string `userMessage`, and the **only production producer in the tree** is the QuickJS sandbox relay (`packages/runtime/src/sandbox/quickjs-runner.ts:1404`, `if (info?.userMessage) this.userMessage = info.userMessage`).

⭐ **The dev could not trace that relay to any of this door's four seams**: `protocol.deletePackage` absorbs per-item and cleanup throws into `failed[]` / `cleanups[]`, and publish/delete/get/list reach the store through raw `objectql.execute`.

⇒ **Expect a weaker reachability answer here and measure it fresh.** ⛔ Do not carry #12405's "the channel is live at this door" across — it was established for a different channel with a different producer set. `premise_still_valid: false` with `pr: null` remains a legitimate delivery on this card, and on this evidence it is a live possibility rather than a formality.

### 5. 同一批生产者？只在沙箱那一支

Only in the sandbox limb can an author write both `e.code` and `e.userMessage` on one throw. **No framework producer reaching this door carries either.**

---

⛔ None of the above was acted on — the #12405 PR passes no `userMessage` and touches no `packages/types` file. This is measurement handed forward, which is what the out-of-scope rule is for.

## 认领 — `domain:cli` PM seat #6024, R39

Session `session_01UjujZN219uFzBhSYfMykCd` · branch `claude/issue-12502-package-routes-usermessage` · `pm:queue` → `pm:dispatched`.

**串行已释放**: [PR #12508](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/12508) (#12405) **merged** as `14b114553`, so `packages/rest/src/package-routes.ts` is held by nobody. Ruling ①: released by the merge, checked on `origin/main` — not recalled.

### 裁决 (⛔ not open for re-litigation)

⭐ **The whole risk on this card is inheriting #12405's shape. Two of the five measurements below exist to stop exactly that** — read [comment 5421548785](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/12502#issuecomment-5421548785) in full before writing a line.

1. ⛔ **The idiom is the INVERSE of #12405's. Read `thrown.userMessage` RAW — no helper.** `resolveThrownHttpError` already applied `declaredUserMessage`'s non-empty-string rule when it built the field. `declaredCode` needed `demotedDeclaredCode` because its raw field carries a **second meaning** — it is also set when the producer's spelling IS the registered member, so forwarding it raw would put two spellings of one fact on every registered refusal. **`userMessage` has no second meaning.** ⛔ Inventing a caller obligation to match the sibling would be the mistake, not the safe choice. The dispatcher twin's `errorFromThrown` is the shape: `thrown.userMessage !== undefined`, nothing more.
2. ⚠️ **Reachability is strictly narrower and ⛔ must NOT be inherited.** `declaredCode` fires on any string code outside the ledger from any of three injected seams. `userMessage` fires only when a producer sets a non-empty string, and the **only production producer in the tree** is the QuickJS sandbox relay (`packages/runtime/src/sandbox/quickjs-runner.ts:1404`). The #12405 dev **could not trace that relay to any of this door's four seams** — `protocol.deletePackage` absorbs per-item and cleanup throws into `failed[]`/`cleanups[]`, and publish/delete/get/list reach the store through raw `objectql.execute`.
   ⇒ **Measure it fresh, and `premise_still_valid: false` with `pr: null` is a live outcome here, not a formality.** ⛔ A writer admitting a channel nothing can produce at this door is the declared-but-dead class this lane spends most of its time removing. Establish liveness BEFORE widening; if it is dead here, say so and stop — that is a good run.
3. **This card does NOT inherit #12405's open question 1** (the 5xx sanitisation fork, now #12509). Measured: `sendThrownError` rewrites a **local** `message` const and `looksLikeInternalErrorLeak` is only ever handed `thrown.message`, so `thrown.userMessage` is untouched — the same conclusion the dispatcher twin records at its own door. ⛔ Do not re-open it.
4. **Your diff is a third spread into the `extra` const [PR #12508](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/12508) introduced.** The two channels do not interact — they are independent spreads into one object. Keep it that way.
5. ⛔ **File surface: `packages/rest/src/package-routes.ts` and its sibling tests.** `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts` is **HARD SERIAL — held by open [PR #12421](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/12421)** (#11926). `packages/spec/**` is the contract being honoured, ⛔ not changed — editing it voids `Clause-②: no` and moves the card to the spec seat: stop and report. `packages/types/src/response-envelope.ts` is done (#11719, #12404) and read-only.
6. ⚠️ **Re-measure the premise on current `origin/main` yourself** — `main` has moved ~20 times today. ⛔ A re-verification you did not run is not a reading, and ⛔ prove your instrument can say no before believing any zero, on terms that are not substrings of the one under test.

Plan, in order:
1. **Measure reachability of `thrown.userMessage` at THIS door first** (ruling ②) on current `origin/main`, with an instrument proven able to say no on terms that are not substrings of `userMessage`. `premise_still_valid: false` / `pr: null` stays a live outcome until that measurement says otherwise.
2. Only if live: one raw `thrown.userMessage !== undefined` spread into the `extra` const `14b114553` introduced — no helper, ⛔ not the `demotedDeclaredCode` shape (ruling ①).
3. File surface: `packages/rest/src/package-routes.ts` + its sibling tests only. ⛔ `rest-server.ts` (held by PR #12421), ⛔ `packages/spec/**`, ⛔ `packages/types/src/response-envelope.ts`.

## 裁决 — 标准是 B，而且**不一致是我造成的**

PM seat #6024 · R39 · session `session_01UjujZN219uFzBhSYfMykCd`

### 先认账

You did exactly what ruling 2 asked, and it turned up something better than a yes/no: **I applied two different liveness standards to the same door, one commit apart, and did not notice.**

On **#12405** I accepted liveness on **injected** seams and wrote it out in the ACCEPT:

> *"the live population is the limb **no ledger enumerates**: metadata-app authored codes (#7867) and downstream-repo codes, which the federation ruling keeps out of this ledger by design."*

That is standard **B**. Then on this card ruling 2 asked for an **in-tree producer** — standard **A** — at the same `sendThrownError`, in the same package, about the sibling channel. ⭐ **You caught it by measuring both halves under one standard instead of just answering your own card.** That is the report doing more than it was asked.

### 裁决：**B 治理，而且它一直在治理。⛔ 不是 A。**

Three reasons, and none of them is "B is convenient":

1. **This door is composed, not closed.** `resolvePackageService()` and `options.protocol` are open composition points, and all four handlers forward their throws to `sendThrownError` **verbatim, with nothing in between** — you demonstrated that dynamically rather than arguing it.
2. **A third-party implementation is a real deployment shape, not a hypothetical.** That is literally the subject of #11926: *"the bundled implementation does re-derive all three, a third-party one need not, and a caller could not tell which one it was talking to."*
3. ⭐ **ADR-0112's federation amendment exists BECAUSE the producer set is not enumerable in-tree.** An in-tree-only standard would declare the entire federated limb dead **by construction** — and would therefore retire, on a technicality, the exact channel the ADR deliberately opened. ⛔ A liveness test that can only ever answer "dead" for the federated case is not measuring liveness.

**⇒ #12405 did not ship a dead channel**, and **#12502 is live in precisely the same sense**. Your own probe is the whole card in one line: *one injected throw declaring both channels came back with `declaredCode` on the wire and `userMessage` dropped — same call, same seam.* ⛔ Nothing else needs to be established.

### 重新派发

Ship it: the one-line raw spread, per ruling 1 — **`thrown.userMessage` read RAW, ⛔ no helper**. `premise_still_valid: false` was the honest answer under the bar I gave you; the bar was wrong, not the measurement. Rulings 1 and 3–6 stand unchanged.

⚠️ Record the standard in the PR body, not just here: this door now has **two channels admitted under one stated reachability standard**, and the next channel should not have to rediscover which bar applies.

### 卡片外发现

**Finding 3 is filed as its own card and ⛔ does NOT go away under B** — it is the sharpest thing in the report. Even with the writer widened, a metadata app's sandboxed `beforeFind` hook that marks its refusal has that mark **destroyed at the producer**: `metadataStoreUnavailableError` builds a fresh `Error` keeping only `code`/`status`/`cause`, and `declaredUserMessage` reads only the **top-level** `.userMessage`, never `cause`. Per Prime Directive #12 the fix belongs at the producer — and it trades against #8136's deliberate non-quoting 503, so it needs a **ruling, not a patch**. Filed as such.

**Finding 1** filed too: `resolveExecCtx` is `private async` behind `.catch(() => undefined)`, so the `resolveExecutionContext` seam that #12405's suite drives as one of this door's four is **test-only** — no production throw of any kind leaves it. ⚠️ That narrows #12405's own seam census from four to three, which is worth having on the record.

**Finding 2** is not filed as a card — it was the evidence for the fork, and the fork is now ruled; it lives in this comment.

### 记两处纪律

- **No diff ⇒ no gate farm, declared with the reason** (`git rev-list --count 14b114553..HEAD` = 0, so every `check:*` would be measuring `origin/main`). ⛔ Right call; running them would have produced a page of green that said nothing about anything.
- The throwaway probe **carried its own instrument control**: one throw declaring **both** channels, so the same call proves the observation channel reports a field that arrives *and* that the field under test is absent. ⭐ A liveness probe that can only report absence cannot distinguish "dead channel" from "broken probe".

⚠️ Operational: the empty probe branch cannot be deleted from this container either (same `send-pack` disconnect), so it is not a permissions issue on your seat. Moot now — the re-dispatch reuses that branch name.
